data.action: 全裸立于花洒水幕下，水珠顺着白皙肩颈与胸腹流淌，仰头轻抚锁骨
data.description: 【艾莉 · 浴室水汽·湿发与薄透水痕】被浓郁水汽包裹的玻璃淋浴间内，温热的花洒水幕顺着艾莉银白湿发与玲珑曼妙的娇躯流淌而下。她抬手轻轻抚过优美的锁骨，眼波流转满是动情——「水流好舒服……但被你隔着玻璃这么一直看着，身体……反而变得更烫了。」
data.lighting: soft diffused warm bathroom light filtered through steam
data.promptProse: Viewed through the steamy shower glass, she tilts her face upward beneath the water with one hand at her collarbone. Warm bathroom light diffuses through the steam and outlines her wet hair.
data.title: 艾莉莎·米哈伊洛夫娜·九条 · 浴室水汽·湿发与薄透水痕
data.animaCaption: Her face tilts into the water, one hand resting at her collarbone behind the steamy glass.
